cds.title: East Texas A&M University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

stats.notes: CDS C1 (fall 2025 first-year class). Residency split: in-state 10,937 applied / 8,463 admitted / 1,092 enrolled; out-of-state 2,130 / 1,577 / 51; international 408 / 315 / 19 (about 77% of international applicants admitted). Undergraduate enrollment 10,260 and nonresident undergraduates 217 are the B1/B2 'Total Undergraduates' figures; the 16:1 student-to-faculty ratio is CDS section I (College Navigator shows 17:1). No waiting list, early decision or early action. Test-optional in practice, so SAT/ACT percentiles describe the 43% (SAT) and 8% (ACT) of enrollees who submitted scores.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A (Fall 2027): SAT or ACT 'recommended'. Admission is granted on any one of top-30% class rank, ACT 21 or SAT 1060.

cost.notes: CDS G1/G5 (first-year; 'other' is the resident-student figure). Tuition and fees are flat per year under the university's guaranteed tuition plan; the university cost page for 2025-26 shows a slightly different non-resident tuition-and-fees total ($22,266 vs $22,176 here). H6: institutional need-based and non-need-based aid are both available to nonresidents; 24 received it (average $9,622, total $230,923).
